notes: Placement complete. Partial: copula/basic noun sentences; question words; negative forms; adjectives. Weak: core particles; polite verb present/past; ある/いる; counters/time; て-form familiarity; requests/permission; wants/plans; basic kanji recognition; short practical reading; active sentence production. Secure evidence: ～ですか question formation, ～じゃないです negative pattern, 駅はどこですか, and 日本. Kana treated as already known per project instructions.

Completed Lesson 001. Core particle roles は/を/に/で were explained in depth after learner feedback requested fuller teaching of new concepts. Initial を/で confusion resolved; に and で used correctly in later production. Polite ～ます/～ました/～ません taught, with ～ませんでした added when an untaught past-negative prompt exposed the gap. Final mastery check 4/4. Earlier errors included 明日/昨日 confusion, one tense mismatch after 昨日, one omitted negative, and one incomplete 買い stem; all were corrected. Learner successfully recalled readings/meanings of 電車, 明日, 昨日, 買います, 行きます and repeatedly used 今日/食べます as well. Planned 三・七・時 were explicitly deferred; untouched placement kanji were rescheduled to avoid overload. 静か was not retrieved and is due for review.

Completed Lesson 002. Existing kanji-bearing vocabulary was reviewed before adding new grammar: 電車・明日・昨日・今日・買います meanings/readings were 5/5, with 行きます and 食べます also retrieved later in production. 静か meaning was recalled, but the learner initially formed 静かません before correcting to 静かじゃないです. Introduced あります/います and the Place に + thing/person が + existence pattern. One guided action sentence used に instead of で, and one early nearby-existence sentence used unnatural order/omitted location に; both distinctions were subsequently corrected. Comprehension of 駅の前 was initially interpreted as at the station rather than in front of the station. Final uncued mastery was 5/5, including あります/います, に/で, が/を, and practical location production. No new kanji batch was added; 三・七・時 remain deferred until the next lesson.

Completed Lesson 003. Due review covered に/で, あります/います, ～ませんでした, 静か＋じゃないです, and Lesson 002 location vocabulary. Initial errors: 近くにコンビニがります omitted あ and final か; 昨日、ホテルに食べました used に instead of action-location で. Both were corrected, while います, past-negative, 静かじゃないです, 前, あそこ, 友達 and 猫 were retrieved successfully. Introduced specific-time に, 何時 questions, and ～から～まで for schedules. The learner initially omitted に in 何時行きますか and once produced 何時に電車がですか instead of 電車は何時ですか; both distinctions later stabilised. 三・七・時 were activated from the deferred set; 八・半・何 were taught actively, while 五・九・十 were encountered in schedule examples. 仕事 and 店 were explicitly unknown as kanji and recorded as new vocabulary rather than assumed mastered. Final uncued mastery check 7/7, including time reading, schedule production, past-negative review, and an accurate explanation of destination に, action-location で, and existence-location に. ここ and そこ were due but not directly tested and remain due.
